verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents multi-currency Jeeves Cash accounts (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD) and manual conversion between them. That is an adjacent multi-currency feature, not the ability to open multiple checking sub-accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows rules that automatically split incoming deposits across sub-accounts.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can open multiple checking sub-accounts and auto-allocate incoming deposits across them
